items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I worked with Buddy Rich quite a bit off the band stand, I did.

ctx.x: Buddy Rich came on the Show a lot, I remember seeing Buddy Rich, Buddy Rich on the Tonight Show a lot.

He came on the Tonight Show and he was, he was a good, fun guy too, Buddy Rich was. He would come on the Tonight Show and we would play and I worked with Buddy Rich quite a bit off the band stand, I did. And Buddy Rich, he liked my trumpet playing. He liked my first trumpet playing, that‘s what he liked about me. And you know Buddy Rich didn‘t read no music, you know. Buddy never read a note in his life, but he didn‘t have to read. He was the best drummer that‘d been through here, you know, in a sense you know…
No, we all respect Buddy. What was it like, since he didn‘t read, how did he rehearse, how did you play?
